definitions.explanation: a sales event where goods are sold at reduced prices

examples.japanese: バーゲン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought it at a bargain sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バーゲン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
バーゲンセール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧になっていた。
examples.english: It was half off at the bargain sale.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From English "bargain".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バーゲン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy at a sale)
- バーゲン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a sale)
- バーゲン⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (sale item)
- バーゲンセール (bargain sale; redundant but common)

WATCH OUT:
バーゲン means a sale event, not a good deal ("That's a bargain!" is ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧! or お{買|か}い{得|どく}だ) and not bargaining over a price (⟦{値切|ねぎ}る→値切る：08360_negiru⟧).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Department stores and fashion retailers hold two big sales a year: the summer sale (⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バーゲン, from about late June into July) and the winter sale (⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バーゲン, starting with the New Year {初売|はつう}り in early January).

RELATED WORDS:
- セール (sale)
- ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧ (special sale)
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (discount)
- ⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧ (price reduction)
